//: Example only -- NOT the default config. Copy the relevant bits into your own
// 2: bliiot_gpio.json rather than using this file verbatim. Demonstrates duplicating
// 3: physical DI/DO/WAN readings to more than one ThingsBoard device from a single
// 4: connector instance, the same pattern the built-in BACnet connector already
// 5: supports by listing the same object under two 'devices' blocks -- see this
// 6: connector's module docstring for why it has to happen inside ONE connector
// 7: instance/ONE gpiod line request rather than two independent connector processes
// 8: (GPIO chardev lines are exclusively locked; two processes requesting the same
// 9: offset would collide with 'Device or resource busy').
name: BLIIOT X26 GPIO Connector

devices.//: Primary device: sees and controls everything -- omitting timeseries/attributes/serverSideRpc entirely means 'no restriction'.
devices.name: BLIIOT X26 IO

devices.//: Second device, duplicating a SUBSET of the same physical inputs/outputs/WAN status to a different ThingsBoard device -- e.g. a restricted dashboard, or a separate customer/tenant device that should only ever see DI1/DI2 (say, a door/security-panel pair) and may only ever switch DO1 (say, a single shared alarm relay), never the other 3 DO channels or any other DI. It never sees the WAN attribute at all (an empty attributes list, not an omitted one).
devices.name: BLIIOT X26 IO - Security Subset
